summary: The door opens and Neo steps back into the Matrix for the first time since his release, squinting at an unnaturally bright sun while being the only one without sunglasses. Apoc and Switch stay at the door as the others move into the alley. Morpheus says they should be back in an hour. Cypher opens the driver's door of an old car as Trinity, Morpheus and Neo approach; he glances about quickly, then drops a cellular phone inside a garbage can, its blue display lighting as the line connects.

what_changes.before: still inside the ship / not yet returned to the Matrix
what_changes.after: physically back in the Matrix for the first time since release, but unprepared for its brightness
what_changes.evidence: for the first time since his release, Neo steps back into the Matrix. He squints at the sun which seems unnaturally bright.

what_changes.before: moving with the group toward the car without drawing attention
what_changes.after: covertly abandoning a connecting phone, acting alone against the crew
what_changes.evidence: Cypher glances about quickly, then drops something inside a garbage can. It is a cellular phone and we see its blue display as the line connects.

event_hint.one_line: The crew arrives in the Matrix to reach the Oracle, while Cypher secretly signals the Agents.

uncertain: Whether Cypher intends the connected line to betray the crew or merely to make a private deal.
